subject: CatalystAI — dedicated density profile & capacity clarifications
messages:
From: Aisha Vargas <aisha.vargas@catalyst.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated sizing intake — initial profile and ask

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. As discussed, CatalystAI is evaluating dedicated capacity with Redwood to power our conversational product (support + proactive suggestions). We want to validate rough fleet sizing and get a recommended starting footprint for an initial production launch (~Q4).

Quick context:
- Expected monthly MAU: ~120k, but active concurrent users at peak (US evening) concentrated in a 3-hour window.
- We use a mixture of short prompts (user utterances ~8–30 tokens) and medium system prompts + context (avg 220 input tokens). Typical response lengths 40–160 tokens.
- We will run a reranking pipeline (small embed + rerank step) on ~10% of requests.
- Target P50 latency for interactive flows: <= 220ms; P95 <= 750ms.
- Initial throughput target: sustain ~1,200 requests/minute during peak. Spikes up to 2,500 RPM for short bursts likely.

Could you send a short questionnaire we can fill (concurrency buckets, token distributions, tail SLO expectations, allowed fallback/quality tradeoffs)? Also attaching a CSV with a small sample of request traces.

Appreciate it —
Aisha
Aisha Vargas
Customer Success Lead, CatalystAI
attachments: sample-prompt-metrics.csv (CSV)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Vargas <aisha.vargas@catalyst.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated sizing intake — initial profile and ask

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the sample traces — helpful. I put together a compact intake template to capture the details our sizing team needs. When you have a moment, please fill the short sections below; I can also schedule a 30m sizing workshop with Dev and Jonas if you'd prefer to walk through it together.

-- Required fields (quick answers welcome) --
1) Peak concurrency window: what fraction of MAU maps to the 3-hour peak? (example: 20% of MAU over 3 hours)
2) Concurrent request distribution: estimate of 1s/5s/15s average per convo (helps with token overlap and KV cache reuse).
3) Avg input tokens and avg output tokens (if you have percentiles, great - e.g., p50/p95 tokens).
4) Fraction of requests that require long-context (>=1024 tokens) and expected average context length for those.
5) Reranking flow: model used (embedding size, CPU or GPU), percent of requests, and desired latency budget for that stage.
6) SLOs: P50/P95 latency targets, and max acceptable error rate or fallback rate.
7) Quantization tolerance: ok to use int8/4-bit quantized models for cost savings vs needing fp16 for fidelity-sensitive flows?
8) Disaster/fallback policy: can we auto-fallback to hosted smaller models or must traffic queue/slow?

Attachments I added: Redwood short sizing worksheet (spreadsheet) and a sample reference footprint for a 1k RPM steady-state workload.

Next steps: If you return the filled template, our pre-sales team will provide: a) recommended GPU SKUs and cluster count for initial commit, b) concurrency and batching settings to hit your latency SLOs, c) suggested quantization profile and expected token/unit cost.

Would you like to book the workshop Tuesday or Thursday at 10am PT?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
attachments: catalyst-density-export.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 07:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Dedicated sizing intake — CatalystAI (quick internal ask)

Dev/Jonas —

Forwarding Catalyst's sample traces and their initial answers (Aisha to fill). Two quick asks before the workshop:
- Dev: please pre-check whether our H100 quantized LLM profile (8-bit+KV-cache) can meet p95=750ms for 1.2k RPM with 220 input tokens / 100 output tokens workload. If not, note the projected GPU count for A100-80GB alternative.
- Jonas: can you prepare a short slide with 3 suggested rollout footprints: conservative (2x headroom), baseline (1.25x), and cost-focused (use int8 aggressive quantization + fallbacks) with cost per 1M tokens estimate. Include notes on batching windows we should recommend.

Also: include a short checklist of the probing tests to run on their sample CSV (prefix reuse, KV cache hit ratio estimate). I'll confirm workshop time with Aisha (aiming for Thu 10am PT).

Thanks —
Mina
From: Aisha Vargas <aisha.vargas@catalyst.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: CatalystAI Sales <sales@catalyst.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated sizing intake — initial profile and ask

Mina —

Thanks for the template, attached is the filled worksheet and a slightly larger sample of traces. High-level answers:
- Peak window: ~18% of MAU concentrated in 3h window (roughly 21.6k users in that period).
- Concurrency: average session duration ~12s; estimate concurrent requests at peak ~1,350 (aligns with our earlier estimate).
- Tokens: p50 input 210, p95 input 540; p50 output 90, p95 output 260. ~6% of requests require long context (>1024, avg ~1400 tokens).
- Rerank: CPU-based embedding + GPU lightweight reranker for top-5, ~9% of requests incur rerank, latency budget for rerank stage: 120–200ms.
- SLOs: aiming for interactive P50 <= 200ms, P95 <= 700–800ms; willing to accept higher p99 during brief spikes.
- Quantization: open to int8 for most flows; fidelity-sensitive routes (billing/ops) need fp16.
- Fallback: prefer auto-fallback to smaller hosted model if dedicated capacity saturates.

Files attached: filled-catalyst-worksheet.xlsx, extended-sample-traces.csv

We can do Thu 10am PT for the workshop. Looking forward to the recommended starting footprint and the three rollout options.

Best,
Aisha Vargas
Customer Success Lead, CatalystAI
attachments: filled-catalyst-worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet), extended-sample-traces.csv (CSV)
